messages.subject: Lumen SPA - out to Hargrove, expect a heavy mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

v1 went to Hargrove yesterday. Flagging that this is Rachel - I'd expect her to come in hard on the warrantor cap and the survival period, and she'll almost certainly try to narrow the MAC. Same playbook as always. Worth deciding our give-points before her mark-up lands so we're not negotiating against ourselves.

James

Sarah,

As expected. I've re-saved Hargrove's v2 with their comment bubbles stripped out so it's easier to read on screen - attached. Note this is my re-export, not the file they sent, so don't treat the copy as the file of record; the version of record is the one in the DMS. Their asks: cap to 50%, survival to 12m, non-compete to 12m, de minimis 20% / basket GBP 200k, and MAC carve-outs.

James

messages.subject: RE: Lumen SPA - our positions
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Reviewed. Here's where we hold:

- Cap: come off 100% but not to 50%. Land at 75%.
- Survival: hold nearer 15 months, not 12. A single audit cycle isn't enough on an AI business with this IP profile.
- Non-compete: 24 was always ambitious; 18 is defensible and enforceable. Give to 18.
- De minimis / basket: split the difference - 17.5% and GBP 150,000.
- MAC: hold firm. No carve-outs. I'm not giving Crestview's walk-away right away on economic conditions; if Rachel pushes, we hold.

Run it past Margaret for sign-off, then put it to Hargrove as a package.

Sarah
